attrs.evidence: GPT-5.6's reproduction against the finished INV-R6.2 artifact. `EMB-CUT-EMPTY` and `EMB-BATTERY-SPLIT` are both PROVED and both rest on scripts/emb-battery-control.mjs. That file appears in no receipt manifest and in no `gates_run`. Modifying it so its final failure exit can never fire, and leaving the receipt untouched, left `check-mosaic`, `check-lineage` and `check-claim-ledger` all exiting 0. A receipt that promotes a claim without binding the bytes of its proof is not describing the evidence state it promoted. THE CLOSURE WALKER IS NOT NEW TO THIS ARTIFACT: make-invariant-review-bundle.sh has computed the transitive import closure of every named witness since round 2.1, when the archive shipped test/laws.mjs beside one of the twelve modules it imports and existsSync reported true the whole time. It was used to decide what to COPY INTO THE ZIP and never to decide what to BIND. scripts/factory-scope.mjs is that same walk pointed at the manifest, and the manifest went from 23 paths to the derived closure.
attrs.gap: DECLARED rather than PROVED, and three gaps are load-bearing. (1) The import walk is STATIC: a dynamic `import()` with a computed specifier is invisible to it, which is DEF-REPRO-DYNAMIC-IMPORT and no witness in the tree uses one. (2) Closure covers what the registries REFERENCE; a proof that lives only in a human's head, or in an evidence file no record names, is outside it by construction. (3) The `scripts/`, `AmpersandBoxDesign/` and `opensentience.org/` roots are closure-only rather than walk-closed, because those directories are shared with other lanes in the source tree; a factory file that no derivation reaches is caught only by the git-tree mode, which needs the repository.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6's audit of INV-R6.2, §7. in-toto: a step records its exact materials and products, and verification checks the links against the layout — provenance is a relation between an exact step, exact inputs and exact outputs.
attrs.statement: A transition receipt binds the transitive evidence closure of every settled claim and decision it promotes — witnesses, argument evidence, instrument implementations, incident reproducers, and the relative-import closure of every executable among them — not only the registries and gates the transition itself invoked.
